data.gender_notes: Frodin is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Old English words 'frod', meaning 'wise' and 'gin', meaning 'kin' or 'family'. This name was given to those who were brave and strong protectors within their communities. The name Frodin carries the meaning “Fearless protector” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Frodin usually hope their child will grow to embody fearless protector and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Frodin belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Fearless protector.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Frodin total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
